# Local animation dependencies

GSAP 3.13.0 and ScrollTrigger 3.13.0 are vendored from the official `gsap` npm package, served by jsDelivr. Their original license banners are preserved in both JavaScript files.

- GSAP: https://gsap.com
- License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
- Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.13.0

No CDN requests are made by the running page. Font licenses are in `assets/fonts/`.
